title: Sub-micron smoke is better seen by an ionization detector
text: For the conditions of the SAME experiment, all samples produced significant numbers of sub-micron particulate that are better detected using an ionization smoke detector.

sources.title: PSI-102 Reports SAME Final Science Report

title: BASS-II results feed fire-safety models used on Earth
text: BASS-II results contribute to the combustion computational models used in the design of fire detection and suppression systems in microgravity and on Earth.

sources.title: Burning and Suppression of Solids - II

title: Very low airflow can quench a fabric flame
text: By decreasing concurrent-flow speed to a very low value (around 1 cm/s), quenching extinction was observed.
